elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: TrueLink warrants that the Hosting Services and Support Services “will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.”

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: TrueLink warrants that the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The software conformance warranty lasts only ninety days following delivery.
The Hosting Services and Support Services warranty lasts only thirty days following performance.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The stated remedy includes “repair or replacement” of non-conforming software or Services.
The stated remedy includes a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming software or Services.

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no warranty that TrueLink will comply with applicable laws.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no warranty concerning malicious code.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The Interface and all related software are warranted to conform in all material respects to their documentation for ninety days following delivery.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: The Hosting Services and Support Services are warranted to be performed professionally and workmanlike for thirty days following performance.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The stated remedy includes repair or replacement of the non-conforming software or Services.
The stated remedy includes a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming software or Services.
